Every z of a 'zo' pair on the page sits on the line with no tail; tailed forms are all coded 3 already (8.1, 6.2, 7.2, 10.4, 13.3, 13.4, 17.6, 18.5, 22.2, 25.5, 26.1, 27.3, 27.4, 29.1 checked)
